text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today marks the start of a long and
arduous
journey in the Twinkle Series for
me and my
trainee. Her name is...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Heya, how's it going? The name's Mejiro
Palmer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I might be like,
part of the Mejiro family, but
don't mind that. I'm just here to
make a name for myself by doing my
thing and running freely.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Aaanyways, enough sappy stuff! I'll be
counting
on you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so begin my days challenging the
Twinkle
Series with
<chrname>!
